item.content:encoded:
Ghost Mutt Records are releasing the soundtrack to 2D platformer Atomic Owl on vinyl. The soundtrack was previously released on vinyl as part of the game’s Kickstarter, but this reissue marks the first time the vinyl soundtrack is available for standard purchase.

The release is a single LP on pink translucent colored vinyl. It is housed in a single-pocket jacket with new artwork by Neondemon.jpg. The reissue is a pressing of 100 copies.

It is priced at $35 and is in stock and ready to ship. It can be ordered via Ghost Mutt Records here.

item.content:encoded:
Black Screen Records are releasing the soundtrack to upcoming action-adventure game Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy on vinyl. They also released the vinyl soundtracks to A Plague Tale: Innoncence in 2019 and A Plague Tale: Requiem in 2022.

The release will be a 2LP on “minoan sphere” green translucent with iridiscent pearl swirl colored vinyl. It will be housed in a gatefold jacket with game art.

The release is available with and without a print. Early preorders are able to get a signed version of the print as well.

It is priced at €39 without print and €45 with the print and it is scheduled to release in November, 2026. It can be preordered via Black Screen Records here.

US folks can also preorder via Cartridge Thunder here or Arcline Store here. Canadians can also preorder via Very Ok Vinyl here.

The release will be a 2LP available in two … Continue reading Lost In Cult to reissue the Starbound soundtrack on vinyl →

The post Lost In Cult to reissue the Starbound soundtrack on vinyl appeared first on Blip Blop.
item.content:encoded:
Lost In Cult Records are reissuing the soundtrack to space sandbox game Starbound on vinyl for the game’s 10th anniversary. The soundtrack first received a vinyl release from Yetee Records back in 2017, which have been sold out and hard to find for a long time.

The release will be a 2LP available in two vinyl color variants – a limited “Erchius Fuel” variant on purple marble colored vinyl, and a “black void” standard black vinyl variant.
It will be housed in a gatefold jacket with new artwork by Kkcit. 500 copies of the “Erchius Fuel” variant will also be available with a certificate of authenticity signed by composer Curtis Schweitzer.

It is priced at £40 and there is no estimate for when it will begin shipping. It can be preordered via Lost In Cult here.

The post Lost In Cult to reissue the Starbound soundtrack on vinyl appeared first on Blip Blop.

The release will be a single LP available in two vinyl color variants – a liquid-filled variant (200 copies), and a mint green colored vinyl variant (600 copies). They … Continue reading A second volume of music from Persona 5: The Phantom X now up for vinyl preorder via A+ Record →

The post A second volume of music from Persona 5: The Phantom X now up for vinyl preorder via A+ Record appeared first on Blip Blop.
item.content:encoded:
A+ Record are releasing a second volume of music from the RPG Persona 5: The Phantom X on vinyl. They released the first volume in 2025.

The release will be a single LP available in two vinyl color variants – a liquid-filled variant (200 copies), and a mint green colored vinyl variant (600 copies). They will be housed in a jacket with game art.
The set also includes four 12″x12″ lyric sheets with game art, a holographic art card, a disc holder, 1 of 5 randomly included stickers, and a redemption card for an in-game item.

The liquid-filled variant is priced at 359 RMB and the colored at 269 RMB. Both are set to release in late October, 2026. They can be preordered via Taobao here, although please note that a Chinese address or proxy service is required to order.

Vol. 1 did have Western distribution as well, although as of this post going up there are no news of such distribution for Vol. 2.

item.content:encoded:
Sonic R vocalist TJ Davis has launched a Kickstarter campaign in order to fund a new EP with new arrangements of music from Sonic Frontiers. A vinyl option is also available.

If successful the vinyl release will be a 12″ EP on blue with white splatter colored vinyl. There are currently no details on the packaging.

The vinyl rewards start at £45 (and is also included in several higher reward tiers). The campaign runs from now and until August 16, 2026. If the campaign succeeds rewards are slated to start shipping in February, 2027. The EP can be backed on Kickstarter here.
